output.content: I pulled the execution logs for the last three weeks to verify the nightly retraining sequence. The job proceeds directly from feature engineering to model fitting. There is no intermediate step where the system searches for optimal hyperparameters. The configuration file defines a single fixed set of values for the learning rate and tree depth, which are applied identically to every store cluster. I checked the code repository history and found no merge requests or commits related to tuning loops or cross validation grids. The pipeline simply reads the current data, applies those static parameters, and writes the new model artifact to storage. The entire process runs in under four minutes, consistent with a single pass fit rather than an iterative search.
